title: PR #179: build(deps-dev): bump tsdown from 0.23.3 to 0.23.4 in the packages group across 1 directory
content:
Bumps the packages group with 1 update in the / directory: [tsdown](https://github.com/rolldown/tsdown). Updates `tsdown` from 0.23.3 to 0.23.4
Release notes

Sourced from tsdown's releases.

v0.23.4

   🚀 Features

  • cjs: Warn when platform is ignored for the CJS format  -  by @​sxzz and @​sxzzbot in rolldown/tsdown#1111 (58003)
  • config: Support multiple env files  -  by @​sxzz and @​sxzzbot in rolldown/tsdown#1110 (5d558)

   🐞 Bug Fixes

  • attw: Apply profiles to file-based problems  -  by @​sxzz and @​sxzzbot in rolldown/tsdown#1108 (a853d)
  • config: Ignore empty env file paths and scope env deps per watcher  -  by @​sxzzbot (17bd0)
  • css: Inline ?inline CSS imported from dependencies  -  by @​sxzz and @​sxzzbot in rolldown/tsdown#1109 (75a78)

   🏎 Performance

  • Use tinyps in hooks  -  by @​43081j in rolldown/tsdown#1112 (f925e)
    View changes on GitHub
Commits
  • 83b6fb5 chore: release v0.23.4
  • 8e22a34 chore: upgrade deps, hoist regex patterns
  • f925e52 perf: use tinyps in hooks (#1112)
  • 17bd0fc fix(config): ignore empty env file paths and scope env deps per watcher
  • 5800398 feat(cjs): warn when platform is ignored for the CJS format (#1111)

  • 75a78ce fix(css): inline ?inline CSS imported from dependencies (#1109)
